# Rule tags and their implementations (generated by tools/map/gen.py; do not edit)

A tag is a rule of the design documents cited in a comment (`D25.3`, `B9`, `PR-B1`, `C-4`) or a rule code raised in a string (`"SPB_SCHEDULE"`). **Before changing a rule, change it in every layer listed for it**, or know why not. Ownership layers: lower, own, verify, coro, low, codegen, loader, champ.
